case.summary: Case HHG-016 was opened on 2016-12-12 01:39:08 following a customer report from customer C09988 stating they never made the $59.67 online transaction 3534820 on card C09988-K1. Graph analysis identified a card_not_present_new_device pattern with a fraud probability of 0.90 and a fraud verdict. The closed-case classifier scored the flagged transaction 3534820 at 0.70, which originated from a new device Windows |  | edge 16.0 |  that had not been seen on this card before. Following Policy R2, because the customer denied the transaction, the recommended actions are to block the card and create an internal fraud case.
